title: Airset Radiant and Weightless Talc-Free Loose Setting Powder
descriptionHtml:
✓ Loose Powder Formula✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Clean + Planet Aware✓ Radiant Finish✓ Fragrance Free✓ Best for Oily, Combo, Normal Skin

What it is: A weightless and translucent loose powder made with a unique air-cream technology that sets, smooths, and diffuses for a radiant finish.


Highlighted Ingredients:

- Squalane: Mega-hydrator that locks in moisture for a plump, moisturized appearance.

- Aerated-cream technology: Weightless and oil-absorbing.

- Ethically Sourced Mica: Provides added luminosity to the skin.


Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan, gluten-free, cruelty-free, and comes in recyclable packaging.


What Else You Need to Know: Airset Radiant Loose Setting Powder is packed with clean ingredients

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Twist open the sifter.
-Tap some product into the cap.
-Swirl the Saie Fluffy Brush (sold separately) or your favorite powder brush in the cap, working the powder into the bristles so it’s evenly distributed.
-For pinpointed application on high-shine zones, use a tapered brush tip.
-For a radiantly diffused look all over the face, bounce and roll the fluffy edges of the brush along the skin.

Recycling Instructions:
-Make sure your Airset jar is empty.
-Remove the sifter.
-Wipe away any remaining product from the jar.
-Place it in your recycling bin.
-Airset is made of 35% post-consumer recycled plastic.
Ingredients+
-Squalane: A hydrator that keeps moisture locked in so skin appears plump for longer.
-Ultra-fine Silica: Provides a velvety soft touch and silky glide for a smooth appearance.
-Ethically Sourced Mica: Provides added luminosity.

Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Silica, Cetearyl Ethylhexanoate, Squalane, Polysorbate 20, 1,2-Hexanediol, Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Gellan Gum. [+/- May Contain/ Peut Contenir: Mica, Iron Oxides (Ci 7749, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891)].



The list of ingredients is subject to change, please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
